paragraphs.text: Allen Roye received 1,081 votes for the District 5 seat on the Pontotoc County school board. He was the only candidate listed for the seat in the Nov. 3 general election. The county’s five election commissioners signed the official returns on Nov. 12.

In the U.S. Senate race, Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith carried Pontotoc County with 7,504 votes. Democrat Scott Colom received 2,664 and independent Ty Pinkins received 242. The three candidates drew 10,410 votes in the county.

Republican Trent Kelly led the county vote in the 1st Congressional District with 7,872. Democrat Cliff Johnson received 2,395 and Libertarian Johnny Baucom received 134. In the contested District 1, Position 1 race for the Mississippi Court of Appeals, county voters gave John Weddle 7,024 votes and Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr. 2,493.

Readers looking up their own precinct can find the congressional and Senate breakdowns on pages 2 through 4 of the county’s report. School board figures appear on pages 5 through 7. The Mississippi Secretary of State also posts the reports for the other counties.
